name: MYST/Esa1 associated factor 6

function.text: MEAF6 encodes chromatin modification-related protein MEAF6. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion; Ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: MEAF6 encodes chromatin modification-related protein MEAF6. It forms part of the NuA4 histone acetyltransferase complex which is involved in transcriptional activation of select genes principally by acetylation of nucleosomal histone H4 and H2A. This modification may both alter nucleosome - DNA interactions and promote interaction of the modified histones with other proteins which positively regulate transcription. It forms part of HBO1 complexes, which specifically mediate acetylation of histone H3 at 'Lys-14' (H3K14ac), and have reduced activity toward histone H4.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MEAF6 have been reported in CNS tumor with BCOR/BCORL1 fusion and ossifying fibromyxoid tumor, malignant.
